# A13-S41: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

Cool, [████], that I could reassure you!
Everyone is only interested in getting The Synthetic Party out, and sometimes we get so engaged that we might just forget that you are in charge and the artist!

Exciting with the conference! I look forward to hearing more about it.

I have invited many, but unfortunately most respond that they have other plans.
I keep trying…

By the way [████], would you try calling TV2Lorry and see if they want to visit the hub one day for the event and record [████] Editorially you can also try to contact TV2Lorry – they are often up for a somewhat different story, here a company that offers itself during a culture week and with some smart technology and democracy angle! I don't have a specific contact person there – the easiest is to find the editorial office online or call and ask which journalist/editor might be interested in the subject.
